description: Recent visits across all the user's links, newest first: when, which document, who (name or email when the reader gave it, otherwise 'Viewer N'), country, device, reading time and the pages read. Opens by the same visitor within 30 minutes count as one visit. Use it for 'what happened this week' or 'who opened anything today'. Reading this never counts as an open.

limit.description: Visits to return (default 25). Totals cover every visit in the window.

since.description: Time window: 24h, 7d, 30d, 4w, today, yesterday, all, or an ISO date/datetime such as 2026-10-01 (UTC unless an offset is given). Default 7d.

name: recent_activity
title: Recent activity on my links
